upstream.revision_basis: Package version recorded in the reviewed snapshot's pyproject.toml; the snapshot carries no git commit identifier.
upstream.usage_boundary: Review snapshot only. No runtime, packaged, or network dependency on the snapshot; guidance was rewritten for this library's evidence policy and no upstream text, code, payload, or ruleset is shipped.
upstream.attribution: Adapted material is credited by document title and content hash, and the upstream license text is vendored for conservative attribution while the reviewed material remains Apache-2.0.
